events.did: 站在 Malcolm 肩后扫视整排屏幕——车辆监控、无人机画面和在场特工头盔的实时画面
events.quote_anchor: He spun the pencil between his fingers as he scanned the bay of screens—van surveillance, drone views, and live feeds from the helmets of the agents in the field.

events.did: 在另一块屏幕上看到 Mitchell Turner 昏倒在车厢地板上
events.quote_anchor: Another screen showed Mitchell Turner, unconscious on a van floor.

events.did: 本想把年长的 Clarke 姐姐也纳入计划，但考虑到她原始与进化后力量的规模，决定不值得冒让她第三次、也是最后一次复活的风险
events.quote_anchor: given the sheer scale of her power, both original and evolving, Gabriel decided it wasn’t worth the risk of resurrecting her a third and final time.

events.did: 出现在 Gabriel 身后，报告增援正在赶往游乐园
events.quote_anchor: Helena appeared behind him. “Reinforcements are on their way to the park.”

events.did: 威胁 Noah 说只要碰他就掰断对方的手，又盯着对方胸前的摄像头说
events.quote_anchor: “Touch me, and I’ll break your hand.” Eli’s gaze dropped from Noah’s face to the body camera, looking straight at Gabriel.

events.did: 转了两下铅笔后作出决定，让 Noah 让 Eli 打头阵
events.quote_anchor: Gabriel turned the pencil once, twice. Then made a decision. “Noah,” he said. “Let Eli take the lead.”

events.did: 命令 Eli 除非他下令否则不许开一枪
events.quote_anchor: “Eli,” he instructed. “You will not fire a single shot unless I tell you to.”

events.did: 从死去特工身上取下东西后起身，一脚踩在镜头上掐断了画面
events.quote_anchor: He rose, and brought his boot down on the lens, killing the feed.

relations.did: 仍然控制着 Eli，把他的持续反抗看成孩子试探父母定下的规矩
relations.quote_anchor: He was still pushing back against Gabriel’s control, a petulant child, testing parental rules.

relations.did: 是那个看重忠诚与合作的军人，与独来独往的自以为是杀手 Eli 构成对照
relations.quote_anchor: One was a dedicated soldier who valued loyalty, cooperation, and the other was a self-righteous killer who worked alone.

relations.did: 是另一个能力与 Gabriel 相近却不相同的 EO，她无法控制自己带回来的人
relations.quote_anchor: For example, Sydney Clarke couldn’t control the people she brought back.

relations.did: 在主机键盘上作业，向 Gabriel 传送目标位置和各处动静的文字信息
relations.quote_anchor: Malcolm’s hands were a blur across the mainframe keyboard.

numbers.who: the two agents in the field
numbers.did: 两名在外的特工头盔信号变黑，两人都已死亡
numbers.quote_anchor: Of the last, two had gone dark. The signals themselves hadn’t been lost, but the agents were dead, body cameras facing down on pavement, or up on empty night.

numbers.did: 这个园子有四个进出口
numbers.quote_anchor: “—wait for reinforcements,” Noah was saying. “The park is large and there are four ways in and out.
An hour until dawn, and the place was still little more than layered shades of black beyond the headlights.

numbers.did: Gabriel 认为冒让她第三次、也是最后一次复活的风险不值得
numbers.quote_anchor: Gabriel decided it wasn’t worth the risk of resurrecting her a third and final time.

numbers.did: 红外图像里一个身体呈暖金色，另一个偏紫蓝
numbers.quote_anchor: Overhead, the drone found its targets. The infrared images came in. One body glowed a warm gold. Nearby, a second registered in cooler shades of violet, blue.

numbers.who: the two agents who survived the fall
numbers.did: 两名从高处坠落幸存下来的特工都说他们什么也没看见
numbers.quote_anchor: According to the two who’d survived the fall, they’d both seen nothing.
